_comment: Command result kojo `<COM>` (Plan_KojoTemplates.md §7.11): fetched after execution (EvaluationPackage.LogMessage_Kojo). EP levels first - facts fixed per lookup - then each EP branch is a full `interaction` tree whose own lines are its fallback. Refusals belong in `<COM>_Refuse` (template commandRefuse; the engine call is not wired yet): refuse branches here are errors.
label: 指令结果口上
_comment_fallback: Accepted results only: requireEPSuccess keeps its default (true) so a refusal never reaches the accept fallback. The receiver can be asleep / time-stopped, the target time-stopped.
_comment_required: Leaves every bound entry must have, by the facts of the commands using the key (pair / solo / d20). path = leaf ids, outer to inner (levels in between may be skipped). Each required leaf needs its own lines. D20 failure = the leaf's own lines below the success child.
_comment_extras: Tags the engine adds to command kojo when a first experience happens in the act (EvaluationPackage.GetFirstExperienceTags). Enable per entry (templateExtras) where that class can be taken.
